description: Sam Neill, a renowned actor, has reportedly filmed his role in the upcoming live-action 'Legend of Zelda' movie prior to his death, as per Deadline.

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: Sam Neill, known for his roles in various films and television series, has reportedly completed filming his part in the live-action adaptation of 'The Legend of Zelda' before his passing. This information comes from Deadline, a reputable source in the entertainment industry.

sections.heading: Casting Details
paragraphs: According to Deadline, other actors set to star in the film include Dichen Lachman and Yvonne Strahovski. Additionally, Uli Latukefu has been confirmed to play the lead villain role of Ganondorf, as sources have informed Deadline.

sections.heading: Rumors and Speculations
paragraphs: Nintendo Everything has reported a rumor about the actor for the character Ganondorf in the live-action Zelda movie, but it is important to note that this information is not yet confirmed and should be taken with caution.

faq.q: What is the 'Legend of Zelda' movie about?
faq.a: The 'Legend of Zelda' movie is a live-action adaptation of the popular video game series of the same name. The film will feature a cast that includes Sam Neill in a role he completed prior to his death.

faq.q: Who are some of the confirmed actors in the 'Legend of Zelda' movie?
faq.a: Deadline has confirmed that Sam Neill, Dichen Lachman, Yvonne Strahovski, and Uli Latukefu are part of the cast, with Latukefu playing the lead villain role of Ganondorf.
